requirement: The system shall verify AUTOSAR E2E message frames by calculating CRC-32 over Data ID, alive counter, and payload, discarding frames with CRC mismatch or sequence gap.

constraints.description: Include Data ID identifier into the CRC calculation
Compute and verify 32-bit CRC against received checksum
Track monotonic sequence counter and detect gaps
Drop corrupted frames on CRC mismatch
Return E2E_OK status on valid frame authentication
